name: prompt-composer-queued-follow-ups
title: Chat composer: Queue follow-ups while a reply streams
description: Chat composer: Queue follow-ups while a reply streams. Chat/ChatInput pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/chat/ChatInput and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.
